title: finding(types): `no document among the 556` is stated twice in the strict-authoring-face argument and nothing derives it — the census it cites prints a live count
body:
Found while implementing objectui#9004, which removed a stated docs-page population from `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` and from the eager-closure gate's header. ⛔ Not fixed there: different package, different corpus, its own decision.

## The instance

The load-bearing argument for why the strict authoring face needs a population pin rather than a document pin is written in the header of `deriveStrictAuthoringSchema`'s type guard in `packages/types/src/strict-authoring-face.ts`, and again in the docblock of the population pin in `packages/types/src/__tests__/strict-authoring-face-8345.test.ts`. Both price the corpus with the same literal:

- source: "⛔ Nothing in the corpus could catch that: no document among the 556 carries an undeclared key inside those 6 objects"
- test:   "the corpus cannot close the gap either, because no document among the 556 the measurement script reads carries an undeclared key"

⇒ Nothing derives `556`. The measurement script prints its own corpus size on every run; these two sentences state it instead, and neither declares the commit it was read on. Same shape as objectui#8629 and objectui#9004: a number in prose that nothing can fail when it moves, copied into a second carrier so the two can drift apart as well as from the tree.

## ⭐ Why the argument does not need the number

⭐ The claim these sentences carry is **"zero"**, not "556". The load-bearing fact is that *no* document in the corpus exercises an undeclared key inside those objects, so every corpus reading is identical whichever way the walker's guard is written — which is precisely why a population pin was needed. The corpus size is decoration on that sentence, and it is the only part of it that can rot. ⛔ Refreshing the numeral reproduces the defect on a timer.

## What this card has to decide

1. Whether either sentence keeps a number. The honest alternatives are: drop it (the argument is unchanged), or state it against a named commit the way the correct sentences on `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` do.
2. Whether the two copies stay two. They say the same thing in a source header and in the test docblock that depends on it.
3. Whether anything should guard the repair. objectui#7448's pin family reaches workflow headers and named sections of docs pages; a package source header and a test docblock are outside every carrier of it today, which is how both copies got here.

⚠️ Note for whoever takes this: `556` also appears, unrelated to this corpus, in `apps/site/app/components/registerCatalogBlocks.ts`'s header as a Next prerender total. Whether the two are the same number by coincidence or by transplant is worth one reading before either is edited.

Filed by the objectui#9004 developer seat, unassigned, for triage.
